Symptom onset in adulthood is typically insidious, and patients are frequently misdiagnosed with multiple sclerosis, spinocerebellar ataxia, hereditary spastic paraplegia or atypical parkinsonism. Autonomic features such as bladder dysfunction and constipation are frequent.
